originalTitle: US army secretary Dan Driscoll resigns over reported friction with Pete Hegseth
summary: Resignation comes after months of turmoil at Pentagon, from leaked investigation to ousting of senior officials
content: Army secretary Dan Driscoll has handed his resignation to Donald Trump, the White House said on Monday, becoming the latest high-profile figure to depart the defense department. The army official, who is second in line to defense secretary Pete Hegseth, had reportedly been eyeing an exit from the Pentagon amid apparent friction with the secretary. “Secretary Driscoll has been highly effective in advancing President Trump’s agenda to Make America Strong Again at the Department of the Army by providing outstanding leadership during historic military operations, restoring an emphasis on readiness and lethality, assisting with negotiations between Russia and Ukraine, and more,” White House spokesperson Anna Kelly said in a statement to the Associated Press. “The United States Army is more powerful than ever thanks to his work alongside the Commander-in-Chief and Secretary of War,” she added. The news was first reported by the Wall Street Journal. The resignation comes after months of turmoil at the defense department, which has seen numerous incidents, from leak investigations and budget issues to the ousting of several senior officials including the army chief of staff Randy George in April. In June, the army’s commander of its forces in Europe and Africa, Gen Christopher Donahue, unexpectedly stepped down. Driscoll was a George ally, and lamented his departure, as did Republican and Democratic lawmakers. Driscoll told Congress in April that he and his family drove to George’s house following his resignation “and we all gave him a hug”. “That being said, the civilian leadership, the design of our system, is that they get to pick the leaders that they want,” Driscoll added. Driscoll is an Iraq war veteran, tech investor and former adviser to JD Vance, whom Driscoll met at Yale law school. When nominating Driscoll in 2024, Trump called him “a disruptor and change agent”. As army secretary, Driscoll was tapped for the unusual role of key negotiator to try to end the war between Russia and Ukraine. He was also a major force behind trying to cut the red tape for military contractors to quickly develop more drones and counter-drone capabilities as warfare rapidly changes around the world. The Senate confirmed him in February 2025, voting 66-28, following an armed services committee hearing that was largely non-confrontational and focused on how the army could modernize its systems, improve recruiting and beef up the military industrial base.
chineseTitle: 美国陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔因与皮特·赫格赛斯发生摩擦而辞职
chineseSummary: 五角大楼经历了数月的从调查泄密到高级官员被罢免的动荡，随后辞职
chineseContent: 白宫周一表示，陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔已向唐纳德·特朗普递交辞呈，成为最新一位离开国防部的高调人物。据报道，这位陆军官员是国防部长皮特·赫格斯的第二顺位，由于与国防部长明显发生摩擦，他一直在考虑退出五角大楼。白宫发言人安娜·凯利在给美联社的一份声明中表示：“德里斯科尔国务卿在陆军部有效推进了特朗普总统的‘让美国再次强大’的议程，在历史性军事行动中发挥了杰出的领导作用，恢复了对战备和杀伤力的重视，协助俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的谈判等等。” “由于他与总司令和战争部长的合作，美国陆军比以往任何时候都更加强大，”她补充道。该消息最先由《华尔街日报》报道。在此之前，国防部经历了几个月的动荡，发生了许多事件，从泄密调查和预算问题到四月份陆军参谋长兰迪·乔治等几名高级官员被罢黜。六月，陆军欧洲和非洲部队司令克里斯托弗·多纳休将军意外辞职。德里斯科尔是乔治的盟友，对他的离开表示遗憾，共和党和民主党议员也是如此。德里斯科尔四月份告诉国会，乔治辞职后，他和家人开车去了乔治的家，“我们都给了他一个拥抱”。德里斯科尔补充说：“话虽这么说，文职领导层，我们系统的设计，是他们可以选择他们想要的领导人。”德里斯科尔是一名伊拉克战争老兵、科技投资者和 JD 万斯的前顾问，德里斯科尔在 Y 认识了他。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
